SELECT
 CIF_ID
,BANK_ID
,DATE_ID
,CUSTOMER_TYPE
,MAX(CONVERT(DATE,CUST_DOB)) AS CUST_DOB
,MAX(CONVERT(DATE,RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE)) AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
,MAX(AGE) AS AGE
,MAX(DEP_COUNT) AS DEP_COUNT
,MAX(LNS_COUNT) AS LNS_COUNT
,MAX(CCD_COUNT) AS CCD_COUNT
,MAX(TRU_COUNT) AS TRU_COUNT
,MAX(TRY_COUNT) AS TRY_COUNT
,MAX(PROD_COUNT) AS PROD_COUNT
,MAX(DEP_ACCT_COUNT) AS DEP_ACCT_COUNT
,MAX(DEP_MAIN_ACCT_CNT) AS DEP_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
,MAX(DEP_JOINT_ACCT_CNT) AS DEP_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
,MAX(LNS_ACCT_COUNT) AS LNS_ACCT_COUNT
,MAX(LNS_MAIN_ACCT_CNT) AS LNS_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
,MAX(LNS_JOINT_ACCT_CNT) AS LNS_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
,MAX(CCD_ACCT_COUNT) AS CCD_ACCT_COUNT
,MAX(TRU_ACCT_COUNT) AS TRU_ACCT_COUNT
,MAX(TRY_ACCT_COUNT) AS TRY_ACCT_COUNT
,MAX(SEC_ACCT_COUNT) AS SEC_ACCT_COUNT
,MAX(TRB_SEGMENT_ID) AS TRB_SEGMENT_ID
,MAX(TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN) AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN
,MAX(TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT) AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
,MAX(TRB_PURE_CASA_ALL) AS TRB_PURE_CASA_ALL
,MAX(TRB_DEP_MAIN) AS TRB_DEP_MAIN
,MAX(TRB_DEP_MAIN_JOINT) AS TRB_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
,MAX(TRB_DEP_ALL) AS TRB_DEP_ALL
,MAX(TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN) AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN
,MAX(TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT) AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
,MAX(TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_ALL) AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_ALL
,MAX(TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN) AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN
,MAX(TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN_JOINT) AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
,MAX(TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_ALL) AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_ALL
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS INSERT_DTTM
FROM (
/*===============================DEPOSIT===============================*/
SELECT 
 ECD.ORGKEY AS CIF_ID
,EDF.GAM_BANK_ID AS BANK_ID
,EDD.FULLDATE AS DATE_ID
,ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE AS CUSTOMER_TYPE
,ECD.CUST_DOB AS CUST_DOB
,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
,CAST(DATEDIFF(YEAR, ECD.CUST_DOB, EDD.FULLDATE) - CASE WHEN DATEADD(YEAR, DATEDIFF(YEAR, ECD.CUST_DOB, EDD.FULLDATE), ECD.CUST_DOB) > EDD.FULLDATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END  AS INT ) AS AGE
,CASE WHEN COUNT(EDF.FORACID) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS DEP_COUNT
,0 AS LNS_COUNT
,0 AS CCD_COUNT
,0 AS TRU_COUNT
,0 AS TRY_COUNT
,0 AS PROD_COUNT
,COUNT(EDF.FORACID) AS DEP_ACCT_COUNT
,SUM(CASE WHEN EDA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DEP_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
,SUM(CASE WHEN EDA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'J' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DEP_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
,0 AS LNS_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS LNS_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
,0 AS LNS_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
,0 AS CCD_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS TRU_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS TRY_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS SEC_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS TRB_SEGMENT_ID
,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN
,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_ALL
,0 AS TRB_DEP_MAIN
,0 AS TRB_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
,0 AS TRB_DEP_ALL
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_ALL
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_ALL


FROM EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP EDA
JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM EDD 
	ON EDA.AS_OF_DATE = EDD.FULLDATE
JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
	ON EDA.CUST_ID = ECD.CORE_CUST_ID AND EDA.BANK_ID = ECD.BANK_ID AND EDA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE 
JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT EDF
	ON EDF.AS_OF_DATE = EDA.AS_OF_DATE AND EDF.GAM_BANK_ID = EDA.BANK_ID AND EDF.GAM_ACID = EDA.ACID  
WHERE EDD.MONTH_END = 'Y' 
AND EDA.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
AND ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
AND LEFT(EDF.GAM_SCHM_CODE,2) <> '09' 
AND EDF.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C' 
AND EDF.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y'
AND EDF.DEL_FLG = 'N'
GROUP BY ECD.ORGKEY
,EDF.GAM_BANK_ID
,EDD.FULLDATE
,ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE
,ECD.CUST_DOB
,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE

UNION ALL
/*===============================LOANS===============================*/
SELECT 
 ECD.ORGKEY AS CIF_ID
,ELF.GAM_BANK_ID AS BANK_ID
,EDD.FULLDATE AS DATE_ID
,ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE AS CUSTOMER_TYPE
,ECD.CUST_DOB AS CUST_DOB
,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
,CAST(DATEDIFF(YEAR, ECD.CUST_DOB, EDD.FULLDATE) - CASE WHEN DATEADD(YEAR, DATEDIFF(YEAR, ECD.CUST_DOB, EDD.FULLDATE), ECD.CUST_DOB) > EDD.FULLDATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END  AS INT ) AS AGE
,0 AS DEP_COUNT
,CASE WHEN COUNT(ELF.FORACID) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END  AS LNS_COUNT
,0 AS CCD_COUNT
,0 AS TRU_COUNT
,0 AS TRY_COUNT
,0 AS PROD_COUNT
,0 DEP_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS DEP_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
,0 AS DEP_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
,COUNT(ELF.FORACID) AS LNS_ACCT_COUNT
,SUM(CASE WHEN ELA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LNS_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
,SUM(CASE WHEN ELA.ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE = 'J' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS LNS_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
,0 AS CCD_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS TRU_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS TRY_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS SEC_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS TRB_SEGMENT_ID
,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN
,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_ALL
,0 AS TRB_DEP_MAIN
,0 AS TRB_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
,0 AS TRB_DEP_ALL
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_ALL
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_ALL

FROM EDS.LNS_ACCTAUTHSIGN ELA
JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM EDD 
	ON ELA.AS_OF_DATE = EDD.FULLDATE
JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
	ON ELA.CUST_ID = ECD.CORE_CUST_ID AND ELA.BANK_ID = ECD.BANK_ID AND ELA.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
JOIN EDS.LOAN_FACT ELF
	ON ELF.GAM_ACID = ELA.ACID AND ELF.GAM_BANK_ID = ELA.BANK_ID AND ELF.AS_OF_DATE = ELA.AS_OF_DATE
WHERE EDD.MONTH_END = 'Y' 
AND ELA.BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
AND ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
AND LEFT(ELF.GAM_SCHM_CODE,2) <> '09' 
AND ELF.LNS_ACCOUNT_STATUS <> 'C' 
AND ELF.ENTITY_CRE_FLG = 'Y' 
AND ELF.DEL_FLG = 'N'

GROUP BY ECD.ORGKEY
,ELF.GAM_BANK_ID
,EDD.FULLDATE
,ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE
,ECD.CUST_DOB
,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE

UNION ALL

/*===============================CARDS===============================*/
SELECT
 ECF.CUST_CIF_NBR AS CIF_ID
,'CBC01' AS BANK_ID
,EDD.FULLDATE AS DATE_ID
,ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE AS CUSTOMER_TYPE
,ECD.CUST_DOB AS CUST_DOB
,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
,CAST(DATEDIFF(YEAR, ECD.CUST_DOB, EDD.FULLDATE) - CASE WHEN DATEADD(YEAR, DATEDIFF(YEAR, ECD.CUST_DOB, EDD.FULLDATE), ECD.CUST_DOB) > EDD.FULLDATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END  AS INT ) AS AGE
,0 AS DEP_COUNT
,0 AS LNS_COUNT
,CASE WHEN COUNT(ECF.CARD_ACCT_NBR) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS CCD_COUNT
,0 AS TRU_COUNT
,0 AS TRY_COUNT
,0 AS PROD_COUNT
,0 DEP_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS DEP_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
,0 AS DEP_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
,0 AS LNS_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS LNS_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
,0 AS LNS_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
,0 AS CCD_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS TRU_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS TRY_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS SEC_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS TRB_SEGMENT_ID
,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN
,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_ALL
,0 AS TRB_DEP_MAIN
,0 AS TRB_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
,0 AS TRB_DEP_ALL
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_ALL
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_ALL


FROM EDS.CCD_CREDIT_CARDS_FACT ECF
JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM EDD 
	ON ECF.AS_OF_DATE = EDD.FULLDATE
JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
	ON ECF.CORE_CUST_ID = ECD.CORE_CUST_ID AND EDD.FULLDATE BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
WHERE EDD.MONTH_END = 'Y' 
AND ECF.CUST_BANK_NBR = 70
AND ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'

GROUP BY ECF.CUST_CIF_NBR 
,EDD.FULLDATE
,ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE
,ECD.CUST_DOB
,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE


UNION ALL

/*===============================TRUST===============================*/
SELECT
 ETC.UNIQUE_ID AS CIF_ID
,ETC.BNK_CODE AS BANK_ID
,EDD.FULLDATE AS DATE_ID
,ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE AS CUSTOMER_TYPE
,ECD.CUST_DOB AS CUST_DOB
,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
,CAST(DATEDIFF(YEAR, ECD.CUST_DOB, EDD.FULLDATE) - CASE WHEN DATEADD(YEAR, DATEDIFF(YEAR, ECD.CUST_DOB, EDD.FULLDATE), ECD.CUST_DOB) > EDD.FULLDATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END  AS INT ) AS AGE
,0 AS DEP_COUNT
,0 AS LNS_COUNT
,0 AS CCD_COUNT
,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ETP.PORTFOLIO_NO) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TRU_COUNT
,0 AS TRY_COUNT
,0 AS PROD_COUNT
,0 DEP_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS DEP_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
,0 AS DEP_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
,0 AS LNS_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS LNS_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
,0 AS LNS_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
,0 AS CCD_ACCT_COUNT
,COUNT(DISTINCT ETP.PORTFOLIO_NO) AS TRU_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS TRY_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS SEC_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS TRB_SEGMENT_ID
,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN
,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_ALL
,0 AS TRB_DEP_MAIN
,0 AS TRB_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
,0 AS TRB_DEP_ALL
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_ALL
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_ALL


FROM EDS.TRU_CUST ETC
JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM EDD 
	ON EDD.FULLDATE BETWEEN ETC.SCD_START_DATE AND ETC.SCD_END_DATE
JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
	ON ETC.UNIQUE_ID = ECD.ORGKEY AND EDD.FULLDATE BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
JOIN EDS.TRU_BASELINK ETB
	ON ETB.CIF_NO = ETC.CUST_NO AND ETB.BNK_CODE = ETC.BNK_CODE AND EDD.FULLDATE BETWEEN ETB.SCD_START_DATE AND ETB.SCD_END_DATE
JOIN EDS.TRU_PORTFOLIO ETP
	ON ETP.BASE_NO = ETB.CUST_NO AND ETP.BNK_CODE = ETB.BNK_CODE AND EDD.FULLDATE BETWEEN ETP.SCD_START_DATE AND ETP.SCD_END_DATE
WHERE EDD.MONTH_END = 'Y' 
AND ETC.BNK_CODE = 'CBC01'
AND ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
AND ETP.[STATUS] = 'A'

GROUP BY ETC.UNIQUE_ID
,ETC.BNK_CODE
,EDD.FULLDATE
,ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE
,ECD.CUST_DOB
,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE



UNION ALL


/*===============================TREASURY===============================*/
SELECT
 ETL.VALUE AS CIF_ID
,ETL.BNK_CODE AS BANK_ID
,EDD.FULLDATE AS DATE_ID
,ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE AS CUSTOMER_TYPE
,ECD.CUST_DOB AS CUST_DOB
,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE AS RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE
,CAST(DATEDIFF(YEAR, ECD.CUST_DOB, EDD.FULLDATE) - CASE WHEN DATEADD(YEAR, DATEDIFF(YEAR, ECD.CUST_DOB, EDD.FULLDATE), ECD.CUST_DOB) > EDD.FULLDATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END  AS INT ) AS AGE
,0 AS DEP_COUNT
,0 AS LNS_COUNT
,0 AS CCD_COUNT
,0 AS TRU_COUNT
,CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ETT.COUNTERPARTY_ID) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS TRY_COUNT
,0 AS PROD_COUNT
,0 DEP_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS DEP_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
,0 AS DEP_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
,0 AS LNS_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS LNS_MAIN_ACCT_CNT
,0 AS LNS_JOINT_ACCT_CNT
,0 AS CCD_ACCT_COUNT
,COUNT(DISTINCT ETT.COUNTERPARTY_ID) AS TRU_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS TRY_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS SEC_ACCT_COUNT
,0 AS TRB_SEGMENT_ID
,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN
,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
,0 AS TRB_PURE_CASA_ALL
,0 AS TRB_DEP_MAIN
,0 AS TRB_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
,0 AS TRB_DEP_ALL
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_MAIN_JOINT
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_PURE_CASA_ALL
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_MAIN_JOINT
,0 AS TRB_OB_PHP_DEP_ALL

FROM (
	SELECT *
	FROM EDS.TRY_LEGALENTITY LE
		CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(LE.EXTERNAL_REF, '|')
		WHERE 
		LEFT(LE.EXTERNAL_REF,1)='R'
		AND BNK_CODE = 'CBC01'
		AND [STATUS] = 'ENABLED') ETL
JOIN EDS.DATE_DIM EDD
	ON EDD.FULLDATE BETWEEN ETL.SCD_START_DATE AND ETL.SCD_END_DATE
JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM ECD
	ON ECD.ORGKEY = ETL.VALUE AND EDD.FULLDATE BETWEEN ECD.SCD_START_DATE AND ECD.SCD_END_DATE
JOIN EDS.TRY_TRADES ETT
	ON ETT.COUNTERPARTY_ID = ETL.ID AND ETT.BNK_CODE = ETL.BNK_CODE
WHERE EDD.MONTH_END = 'Y' 


GROUP BY ETL.VALUE
,ETL.BNK_CODE
,EDD.FULLDATE
,ECD.CUSTOMER_TYPE
,ECD.CUST_DOB
,ECD.RELATIONSHIPOPENINGDATE


) A
GROUP BY CIF_ID
,BANK_ID
,DATE_ID
,CUSTOMER_TYPE
